Ministero Italiano dello Sviluppo Economico - 2022 - 2024

## Overview

VeDi 2025 is an Italian Ministry of Economic Development (MISE) funded
research project between Centro Ricerche Fiat (CRF, Stellantis) and the
University of Trento. The goal is a motion planner that lets two or more
autonomous vehicles negotiate a shared maneuver - a merge, an overtake, an
intersection crossing - before either of them commits to it, using
Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communication to exchange intent.

## What I worked on

My contribution focused on the planning side: formulating maneuver
negotiation as an optimization problem where each vehicle proposes a
trajectory, checks it against the intentions broadcast by nearby vehicles,
and converges on a jointly feasible set of maneuvers rather than reacting to
whatever the other vehicle happens to do. The planner runs online, so the
negotiation has to converge fast enough to still be useful by the time the
vehicles reach the interaction point.

## Status

Completed, 2022 - 2024, developed jointly with CRF - Stellantis at the
University of Trento.
